# KovaBook Pro 15

The KovaBook Pro 15 is built for people who need more screen space and more performance without moving to a bulky workstation. Analysts, designers and developers get a large fifteen-inch display, a full keyboard with number pad and enough power for demanding spreadsheets and code builds.

## Performance

The Pro 15 ships with a high-performance processor and an optional discrete graphics card. Its larger chassis allows better cooling, so it can sustain heavy workloads for longer without slowing down.

FACT: KovaBook Pro 15 costs 1450 dollars in the business configuration.
FACT: KovaBook Pro 15 has 32 GB of RAM as standard.
FACT: KovaBook Pro 15 weighs 1 point 9 kg.

## Display

The fifteen-inch screen has a higher resolution than most business laptops and covers a wide colour range, which makes it a good choice for teams that review visual material. Brightness is sufficient for use near windows, though the glossy finish can reflect overhead lights.

## Connectivity and expansion

The KovaBook Pro 15 offers two USB-C ports, two USB-A ports, HDMI, an SD card reader and wired Ethernet, which many office users appreciate when wireless networks are congested. The memory is socketed, allowing future upgrades by IT staff.

## Warranty and support

Business purchases include a three year warranty with next-business-day parts replacement. Kova also offers an accidental damage option for an additional annual fee. Fleet customers receive access to a dedicated support line and a deployment portal for imaging and asset tracking.

Battery life is rated at up to nine hours of typical office use. The included charger is larger than those of thinner models, which travelling staff may want to consider.
